newsitem.title: INDIA: India IDBI repays 7.5pct 1997 bonds June 10.
newsitem.headline: India IDBI repays 7.5pct 1997 bonds June 10.

text.p: The Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) said on Tuesday its 7.5 percent Bonds 1997 (25th series) will be repaid on June 10.
"The principal amount of the 7.5 percent IDBI Bonds 1997 (25th series) is repayable at par on June 10, 1997 with interest due thereon upto June 9, 1997," IDBI said in a statement.

"Investors holding the bonds in the form of promissory notes may tender the bonds at the concerned office of IDBI where they are last enfaced, preferably before May 26, 1997, to facilitate repayment in time," it said.
IDBI is India's largest term lending bank.
